description: Shadowfen mud/wattle building culture — round mud shells, thatch, woven furniture, bone-and-reed ritual props, poled rafts and the Hist tree. Sourced at Phase 11 item 6b to close the inventory's critical mud-culture gap. Contains NO Imperial or reed/stilt pieces: material-culture.md forbids blending the two Argonian cultures in one settlement, so the kits are separated rather than the placement rules. (wovenfence01 and argonianbonechime02 are excluded: both NIFs ship without renderable geometry.) Only plank_ferry_swamp_01/03 and rowboat_ferry_swamp_01 carry real hull geometry in the Skyrim Ferries pool; swamp_02/04/05/06 are editor markers and are excluded. Second sourcing pass adds the Skyfall Hist tree (a second hero-Hist mesh), Hist flowers, the rock cairns and rune circle that stand in for canon grave-stakes, a real dugout canoe and a poled ferry raft.

snapLogic.assemblies: Composites in this kit: `composite:mud/hut-with-entrance` is `hutexterior` + `doorframe01` + the wood door leaf at the offsets BM&V used 22 times (templates bmv-blackmarsh:t0037 and t0091). The rule is that the mud hut shell is an unbroken drum — its entrance is three separate pieces, and a hut placed without them cannot be entered. The bare `hutexterior` stays in the kit for ruins and abandoned shells.

compose.note: BM&V's mud hut with the entrance it is never shipped with. Template bmv-blackmarsh:t0037 (22 placements) puts `doorframe01` at 3.22, -5.98, -3.91 m in the hut's own z-up frame, yawed 153.74 deg; bmv-blackmarsh:t0091 (11) hangs `ruinswooddoorload01` in that frame at 3.19, -5.91, -3.84 m, yawed 245.41 deg. Two further frame offsets in the mine (3.04, -5.57 and 3.42, -6.35) are the same doorway shifted a little along the same wall, so the commonest is taken and the variants left. The door mesh is the vanilla Nordic ruins wood door the BM&V plugin references by path.
